narrative.executive_summary: Across 8 live missions in retail_clothing, the platform faces a systemic inventory logic failure masked as MEDIUM risk. 71 products across three missions (21 + 36 + 14) are flagged for immediate replenishment yet the system recommends 0 units reorder volume, indicating a data integrity or calculation breach that obscures true stockout exposure. Concurrently, demand is dangerously concentrated in 20 high-velocity SKUs led by Biscuits (30 units), Mouse (28), and Sugar (23), amplifying supplier single-point-of-failure risk. Revenue and profit concentration via Gadget Hub (32 transactions, ₹128,265 of ₹820,481 total) and Mouse (₹39,496.35 profit, 20.4% of ₹193,684 total) further elevates operational fragility requiring immediate intervention.

threat_vectors.name: Phantom Replenishment Logic Failure
threat_vectors.description: Three independent missions flagged 71 products for immediate replenishment (21, 36, and 14) but all calculated 0 units recommended reorder volume. This systemic anomaly suggests a broken reorder algorithm or data feed failure, leaving the business blind to actual stockout and lost-sales risk. Risk scores 47, 42, and 38.

threat_vectors.name: High-Velocity Supplier Fragility & Demand Concentration
threat_vectors.description: 20 high-velocity SKUs dominate live demand, with Biscuits (30 units), Mouse (28), and Sugar (23) as top movers. Repeated detection across two missions (risk scores 47 and 39) indicates single-supplier dependency and lead-time vulnerability for these critical SKUs.

threat_vectors.name: Channel and Margin Concentration Risk
threat_vectors.description: Gadget Hub drives 32 units/transactions generating ₹128,265 (15.6% of ₹820,481 total revenue across 422 units), while Mouse alone contributes ₹39,496.35 (29.49% margin, 20.4% of total ₹193,684 profit). Over-reliance on one channel and one high-margin SKU creates outsized earnings volatility.

immediate_actions: Halt reliance on automated reorder outputs and manually audit reorder logic for the 71 flagged SKUs — validate safety stock, lead time, and on-hand calculations within 24 hours
Initiate emergency stock check and proactive replenishment for top 3 high-velocity SKUs: Biscuits (30), Mouse (28), Sugar (23) to prevent imminent stockout
Conduct physical inventory reconciliation for the 14 products flagged under Ghost Restock & Shrinkage Risk to rule out shrinkage, phantom inventory, or system desync
Activate secondary supplier sourcing for the top 20 high-velocity products and confirm lead-time coverage for Biscuits and Mouse
Review Gadget Hub channel dependency — assess contingency sales plan if channel demand decays, given its 15.6% revenue share
monitoring_recommendations: Implement daily automated validation control: any 'replenishment required' flag must have reorder volume >0, with alerts for zero-volume anomalies
Establish weekly high-velocity SKU velocity and supplier health dashboard tracking sell-through, days-of-cover, and supplier fulfillment for top 20 SKUs
Deploy continuous channel and margin concentration monitoring — track Gadget Hub share of revenue and Mouse share of profit with thresholds at >15% and >20% respectively
